description: S459 LOW-MED-3 legitimate twin of union-shaped-member-reject-rt: a date string inhabits `number(>0) | date`, a timestamp string inhabits `number(>0) | timestamp`, and the `pick(v: number(>0) | date)` parameter admits a date string. `asIs` is a developer-signed untyped value that every value inhabits (§7.5.2), so `number(>0) | asIs` admits -5 — that is the type's meaning, not a missing check.
rationale: §53.3.1: a value inhabits a union by inhabiting a member. §7.5.2: `asIs` means a developer signed for it — the deliberate untyped escape hatch.
